If a check cannot pass without data the tool does not have, say UNSOLVABLE: and name the data.
needs_human: K-201 and proposed K-202 guaranteed compressor curves with surge and stonewall lines: If curves show insufficient surge margin or stonewall below the 120% duty, the parallel K-202 split/size in earlier answers fails and a larger or different machine is needed; if they pass, the UNSOLVABLE headline lifts to a pass
